title: Structural integrity load combinations—alternate load path method.
officialText:
Where specifically required by Sections 1614 through 1616, elements and components shall be designed to resist the forces calculated using the following combination of factored loads:

D + f L +f W (Equation 16-26) 1 2

where:

f = 0.25 for buildings in Structural Occupancy Category II. 1

f = 0.5 for buildings in Structural Occupancy Category III or IV. 1

f = 0 for buildings in Structural Occupancy Category II. 2

f = 0.33 for buildings in Structural Occupancy Category III or IV. 2

The live load component f L need not be greater than the reduced live load. 1
